name: B10-0544/2025 (The Left) – EU position on the proposed plan and EU engagement towards a just and lasting peace for Ukraine
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the EU position on the proposed plan and EU engagement towards a just and lasting peace for Ukraine
part_text:
This text is a statement of opinion from a left-wing group in the European Parliament. It does not change any law. It asks the European Union to push for peace talks on Ukraine under United Nations leadership, to back an immediate ceasefire, to cancel Ukraine's foreign debt, and to demand that Russia helps pay for rebuilding Ukraine. It also criticises the European Union for not leading peace efforts and criticises a United States peace plan.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. It is a call for the European Union to act differently.
- **Who it affects:** European Union governments, Ukraine, Russia, and United States-led talks.
- **What happens next:** It is sent to the Council, the Commission, member states, Ukraine, Russia, the United Nations and the Organization for Security and Co-operation in Europe.
